Atlantic Tropical Outlook

NHC issued: 800 AM EDT Thu Oct 22 2026
Subtropical Central Atlantic:
A trough of low pressure located several hundred miles to the east-southeast of Bermuda is producing a large area of disorganized showers and thunderstorms. Some development of this system is possible during the next day or two while it moves slowly north-northeastward. Upper-level winds are forecast to become too strong for further development by the weekend.

E. Pacific Tropical Outlook

NHC issued: 500 AM PDT Thu Oct 22 2026
Western Central Pacific:
An area of low pressure is forecast to form near the International Date Line, a few hundred miles west-southwest of Johnston Atoll late this weekend or early next week. Environmental conditions appear conducive for some gradual development thereafter while the system moves generally eastward to east-northeastward.
